title: Local Bank Account for International Purchases & ATM Use
body:
Hi OzBargainers,
I'm travelling overseas soon and looking for an Australian bank (deposit in AUD) that offers a card for overseas purchases and ATM withdrawals, with no fees and exchange rates at or better than Visa or Mastercard rates.
Something similar to the old Citibank product before NAB took over.
I recently applied for an ING account with similar features, but after a week I'm still waiting on approval, and dealing with their support staff has been a poor experience. I'm not sure it's worth continuing.
Has anyone found a good alternative? Thanks!
Any recommendations?
Thanks!
